name: Roll & Rob the Hero
description:
About This Game

Grow your hero and battle by the roll of the dice!

As a genius gambler, you’ve won everything from the Hero in a game of dice—even his sacred mission!

Now, to defeat the monsters plaguing the village and press forward, you must rely entirely on your luck and the roll of the dice.

<Roll & Rob the Hero> is a highly addictive and unique digital board game that blends the strategic "Roll-and-Write" mechanic with the thrill of an "Auto-Battler."

Complete the Board!

The rules are simple: Roll the dice and place them into slots that match specific conditions.

Whether it's Quests, Dungeons, Exploration, or Enhancements—where and how you place your dice determines your Hero's stats.

Your dice are limited, so design a strategy to fill the board efficiently and maximize your resources.

Defeat the Monsters!

Once you’ve used all your dice, your Hero automatically clashes with the monsters!

This is the moment to see how well you’ve prepared.

The growth and resources gained from previous stages accumulate permanently, giving you a lasting edge.

It starts simple, but as enemies grow stronger, you’ll need expert risk management.

A true gambler prepares for bad luck even during a winning streak.

Collect Relics and Make Companions!

Victory in battle rewards you with powerful Artifacts!

These items boost your Hero's stats or provide bonuses for specific dice values, allowing you to build devastating logical combos.

As you break stage records and climb the tiers, you’ll unlock Pets to aid your journey.

From manipulating dice pips to consuming dice to restore health, Pets offer unique tactical advantages.

About DEMO

The demo version features content up to Stage 4, including 45 types of Artifacts and 4 unique Pets.

Because Roll & Rob the Hero offers such a unique mechanic, your feedback is absolutely vital to us.

We want to hear your thoughts so we can continue to refine and improve the game.

Please let us know what you think! Join our Discord community and let us know what you think!
short_desc: Roll & Rob the Hero is a unique Roll-and-Write Auto-Battler. As a genius gambler who won the hero’s destiny in a bet, you must roll dice to build stats, collect Artifacts, and strategically manage risks to defeat monsters. Experience the thrill of logical strategy and explosive luck.
